nodes.label: Vercel deployment (quizzes-hub.vercel.app)
nodes.rationale: Changes go live only after a commit + push (or redeploy); Vercel rebuilds the site.

nodes.label: Subject page section order
nodes.rationale: User asked for Exam Reviewers and Reviewer Pointers at the top, above Quizzes and Flash Cards.

nodes.label: Timer counts down to a fixed end time
nodes.rationale: Browsers throttle timers in background tabs; checking against endsAt keeps the countdown accurate.

nodes.label: Finals-only exam slots
nodes.rationale: User: this is the finals exam - Prelim and Midterm slots were removed.

nodes.label: Per-item scoring
nodes.rationale: A matching set or enumeration is worth one point per item, so scores stay whole numbers.

nodes.label: CC6 Finals mock exam (179 MC, 120 min)
Ch 8 - Special Purpose Databases and Trends
Chapter 8 slide gaps
nodes.rationale: Cloud-native slide repeats serverless text, multimedia has no definition, temporal slide contradicts itself - left out of questions.

nodes.label: Quiz writing rules
nodes.rationale: No learning-objective questions; skip redundant/overcomplicated details; wording exactly or close to the modules; plausible same-chapter distractors; balanced answer letters.

nodes.label: Pointers PDF rules
nodes.rationale: Times New Roman 12, proper indentation, black text only, clear and not text heavy, all modules compacted into one.

nodes.label: Review Material layout (IPT1 Week 6/7)
nodes.rationale: Format basis only: centered title, italic subtitle, numbered ruled headings, Term - meaning bullets.

nodes.label: Pointers shown as a PDF section, not on-page notes
nodes.rationale: User preferred a Reviewer Pointers card section (like Flash Cards) over the Study Notes tab.

nodes.label: Build verified in a Linux scratch copy
nodes.rationale: Local node_modules is a Windows install, so npm ci + vite build + oxlint run in a separate copy.

nodes.label: PDF-standard Times font fallback
nodes.rationale: Real TNR needs the font files copied into the project; Windows viewers show standard Times as TNR.

nodes.label: Optional timer toggle (off by default)
nodes.rationale: User: don't add a timer, or add a toggle so students choose.

nodes.label: One point per output line
nodes.rationale: Matches the written quiz, where a 5-line snippet is worth 5 points.

nodes.label: Exact per-line output matching
nodes.rationale: The loose normalize() dropped symbols, so '1' matched '-1'; output must match exactly.

nodes.label: WD Finals mock exam (172 MC + 18 output tracing)
WD Ch 6 - Introduction to JavaScript and DOM
WD FT Quiz 1 and 2 items
nodes.rationale: User asked to include the quiz reviewers in the exam and match their output-tracing difficulty.

nodes.label: Answer keys generated by running the code
nodes.rationale: Node runs console snippets and jsdom runs DOM snippets, so no answer is typed by hand.

nodes.label: SPA rewrite to /index.html
nodes.rationale: Direct links like /subject/cc6 returned 404 on Vercel until every path was rewritten to index.html.

nodes.label: Generic pointers PDF builder
nodes.rationale: make_pdf.py reads title, footer and content from each subject's pointers.py.

nodes.label: EA Finals mock exam (97 MC + 49 True/False)
EA Ch 9 - Developing Future Architecture Views
EA Ch 10 - Developing an EA Management Plan
EA Ch 11 - Investment Planning and Project Management
CPIC phase diagram read from slide image
nodes.rationale: Lecture 11 slide 8 is a picture; its four phases and flow were read visually.

nodes.label: Balanced True/False with one-fact false statements
nodes.rationale: About 40-50% false so guessing True does not pay off; explanations give the correct fact.

nodes.label: OOP Finals mock exam (123 MC incl. 8 code items + 13 output tracing)
OOP M10 - Code Reuse and Class Hierarchy
OOP M12 - Abstract Class and Interface
Java code outputs verified with javac/java
nodes.rationale: The module's printed outputs had errors (9 vs 9.0, a C.c1()6 typo), so answers come from running the code.

nodes.label: Code block in multiple choice questions
nodes.rationale: Code-reading MC items need the program shown above the options.

nodes.label: Wrong options match the right one's length
nodes.rationale: OOP started with the correct option longest in 69% of items; rewritten to 36%.

nodes.label: COMPROG3 Finals Exam Reviewer (Ch 6-8, VB.NET)
nodes.rationale: 113 items: 44 true or false, 51 identification, 18 output tracing; style follows the class midterm.

nodes.label: VB snippets verified by Python twins with .NET rules
nodes.rationale: No VB compiler available; helpers follow 0-based Substring/IndexOf, inclusive For...Next, True/False, Like patterns, checked against textbook figures.

nodes.label: Subject password lock (encrypted payload)
nodes.rationale: Locked subject content ships only as AES-GCM ciphertext; PBKDF2 key from username + password; wrong pair fails to decrypt.

nodes.label: No password or hash stored in code
nodes.rationale: Credentials only derive the key, so editing JS or reading the bundle reveals nothing; strength equals the password's.

nodes.label: Plaintext sources of locked subjects are git-ignored
nodes.rationale: locked-src/ and the COMPROG3 reviewer folders stay local; only the .enc.json is committed.

nodes.label: OOP output tracing items run with javac/java
nodes.rationale: 13 Java programs from the module examples; the real printed lines are the answer, scored per line.

nodes.label: Exam parts: take a finals mock exam by chapter/module
nodes.rationale: One exam split into parts from the explanation's Chapter/Module prefix; picker, per-part saved scores, next-part button.

nodes.label: Parts keep long exams from being overwhelming
nodes.rationale: User wanted stops and a choice of module order while the exam stays one whole.

nodes.label: Lilac/pink palette only (no yellow/green outliers)
nodes.rationale: Correct = violet, wrong = pink; user asked to remove off-theme colors.

nodes.label: Scroll to top on route and screen change
nodes.rationale: SPA kept the old scroll position, so pages opened at the bottom on mobile and web.

nodes.label: IPT1 Finals mock exam (176 MC, 3 lessons)
nodes.rationale: Web Services and SOAP, REST and Consuming APIs, Reliable and Secure Data Exchange.

nodes.label: Mixed difficulty: remembering to scenario and evaluating
nodes.rationale: User asked for remembering, understanding, analyzing, scenario, conceptual and evaluating items.

nodes.label: IPT1 Finals Pointers PDF (6 pages, bundled sources)
nodes.rationale: Bundles slides, reading material and the Data Exchange summary.

nodes.label: Exam realism: no module-example items, few scenarios, many definitions
nodes.rationale: User feedback: module examples and situational items will not appear in the real exam.

nodes.label: Pointers PDFs include diagrams (figures.py)
nodes.rationale: User asked for visuals like the IPT review material; black-and-white flow/stack/tree/columns/cycle/nested/triangle/cells figures.

nodes.label: OOP output tracing in the instructor's style (Quiz Set A)
nodes.rationale: Long inheritance-chain programs with field-named getters/setters, super(), overloaded Printer.print(), and state changes between prints.
